title: Academic Stress Management & Coping
content: Academic stress is common among university students. Manage stress by practicing time management (e.g. prioritizing tasks with a Eisenhower matrix) and deep breathing exercises (like box breathing: inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4, exhale for 4, hold for 4). If you feel overwhelmed, break large tasks into smaller, manageable chunks.

title: Anxiety Coping Strategies
content: When dealing with anxiety, use grounding techniques like the 5-4-3-2-1 method: identify 5 things you can see, 4 you can touch, 3 you can hear, 2 you can smell, and 1 you can taste. This shifts focus away from anxious thoughts back to the present moment.

title: Mindfulness and Breathing Techniques
content: Mindfulness involves paying attention to the present moment without judgment. Regular practice, even for 5 minutes a day, reduces stress and improves memory. Close your eyes, focus entirely on your natural breathing, and gently redirect your focus whenever your mind starts to wander.
